name: Lazarus Pharmaceuticals Biomonitor Implant BMI-6
description: A subcutaneous implant the size of a grain of rice that continuously monitors the host's vital signs, blood chemistry, toxicology, and organ function, transmitting data to a linked device or medical facility. The BMI-6 tracks heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, glucose, electrolytes, liver and kidney markers, infection indicators, and the presence of over 200 known toxins. The implant can detect medical emergencies — cardiac arrest, stroke, poisoning, anaphylaxis — and automatically alert emergency services with the patient's location and diagnostic data. It also tracks pharmaceutical levels in the blood, enabling precise medication dosing.

specifications.info: stroke; poisoning; anaphylaxis; typically inner forearm; inductive recharging
specifications.auto-alert: Emergency services with location and diagnostics

story_hooks: A BMI-6 detected a toxin in a patient's blood 3 minutes before symptoms appeared — the early warning saved their life, but the toxin was a rare compound that should not have been in their food.

BMI-6 data from a murder victim reveals a precise timeline of their poisoning — the toxin was administered in three micro-doses over 6 hours, each dose too small to trigger the toxicology alert individually.

physical_description.visual_profile: A rice-grain-sized bioelectronic capsule, barely visible to the naked eye. When exposed during installation or removal, it appears as a sleek metallic-ceramic hybrid with a subtle iridescent sheen. Once implanted, completely invisible beneath the skin.
physical_description.dimensions: 8mm length × 2mm width × 2mm height (subcutaneous implant); External receiver device approximately 12cm × 8cm × 1.5cm
physical_description.weight_description: Implant itself negligible (under 0.5g); External linked device handheld and pocketable
physical_description.primary_material: Biocompatible titanium-ceramic composite shell with sapphire sensor arrays; gold-plated microcontact pins
physical_description.finish: Implant has a polished, slightly iridescent finish resistant to biofluids; external receiver has a matte charcoal polymer housing with anodized aluminum trim
physical_description.color_scheme: Implant: gunmetal gray with hints of violet under light; Receiver: matte black housing with Lazarus Pharmaceuticals' trademark cyan-blue accent stripe along top edge
physical_description.interface_elements: Implant: no user interface (fully passive once inserted). Receiver device: small OLED status display (2.5-inch), capacitive touch panel for menu navigation, dual indicator LEDs (green for normal, amber for alert, red for emergency), inductive charging coil with alignment markers, encrypted Bluetooth indicator light, subtle haptic feedback system
distinctive_features: Microscopic laser-etched serial number on implant barrel
Receiver device features a soft breathing pulse animation on standby (cyan glow cycling)
Inductive charging pad glows faintly blue when device is charging
Emergency alert mode triggers rapid red LED pulsing across top edge
Subtle medical-grade packaging with temperature monitoring label
Lazarus Pharmaceuticals holographic authentication seal on receiver
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Lazarus Pharmaceuticals logo (stylized caduceus with circuit pattern) on receiver back panel; FDA/GLMZ medical compliance stamps; 5-year warranty seal; model number BMI-6 laser-printed on rear; manufacturing batch code and date
physical_description.condition_typical: Implant: sealed within sterile biocompatible housing during insertion; Receiver: kept in leather or synthetic carry pouch, screen may show active vitals dashboard with color-coded parameter readouts; periodic soft blue glow during sync cycles with medical network
